result:
Round 150 is planned and dispatched. The decision is **CONTINUE** (D-29z115).

**Why:** C failed round 149 (V-1a, the scoped Obsidian & Brass colour tokens) on two Lows only, and both were caused by that round. Every other row passed in a real browser (`browserVerified` and `realVerified` are true). Gate 149 was skipped, so HEAD stays `b292ff4` and the round-149 changes are still uncommitted. I checked that they match `a-round-149/end-sha256.txt` (5/5). Round 149's task said in advance that a Low the round caused gets a fix-up by the same owner, folded into V-1b. Nothing needs input from outside.

**Round 150: V-1b plus the two Lows (3 related items, 8 files, no new files)**

| Item | Change | Calculated contrast |
|---|---|---|
| DUX-B-3, field borders | In the Studio-only block, `--color-outline-strong` goes from `#3a3530` to `#736b60`. The BPM, library search and detail From/To/Clip Gain fields switch from `border-outline` to `border-outline-strong`. | 3.50 on surface, 3.30 on elevated (target ≥ 3) |
| C-R149-1, "Loop" label (was 4.32) | Loop brace fill `bg-accent/30` becomes `/20`, the same fill the Loop button already uses when on. | 5.47 (target ≥ 4.5) |
| C-R149-2, Overview playhead (was 1.03 on the gold bar) | Add `ring-1 ring-background`, a 1 px dark outline. No single colour can fix this, and the outline doesn't change the element's size. | 8.32 against the bar and against the dark background |

- **Fewer files than planned:** round 149's task said four components needed field changes; it is three. The group-name and marker-name fields already have `border-brand`.
- **Spec deviation:** `#736b60` departs from the spec's `outline-strong` value, which cannot reach 3:1. It is recorded the same way as the earlier `dim` change. Nothing else in `app/` uses `outline-strong`, so only the three fields change.
- **Tests:** A updates TH2 and adds TH5 (rendered field and playhead classes) and TH6 (the Loop brace class). Six mutations (m119–m124) must turn them red.
- **C's checks:**
  - **Field borders:** each field's border against its real parent background, at least 3.0 measured on screen pixels.
  - **Contrast:** a full re-run, with the "Loop" label at 4.5 or more.
  - **Playhead outline:** at least 3:1 against the bar.
  - **Unchanged elsewhere:** layout within 1 px of the V-0 reference, tokens on both popup surfaces (Export dialog and marker menu), Store pages unchanged, basic behaviour, and anonymous `/studio-lab` with purchase protection.
- **Weak test guard:** after the change, the existing pending-status PM2 test passes only because `border-outline-strong` contains the text `border-outline`. The new TH5 test checks the exact class.

**Backlog (v142), from C's evidence only**
- V-1a is marked bug (ბაგია), not done.
- C-R149-1 and C-R149-2 are added as open findings, scheduled for round 150.
- DUX-B-1, DUX-B-4 and GATE148-S1 passed C's check, but stay open until round 150 passes and rounds 149 + 150 are published together.
- The reviewer's architecture note and its L2/L4 remarks are recorded as signals, not tasks. The architecture checkpoint request is still pending and doesn't block this round.

**Files written:**
- the task: `tasks/round-149.md` (an identical copy of the old task), the new `current-task.md`, `b-round-149.md`, `b-next.json` and a checkpoint;
- `backlog.json`, `feature-status.md` and D-29z115 in `plan.md`;
- the round-150 file permissions and frozen-file hashes, plus copies of the 8 files A may edit, taken before any change.

No store file was changed. The regression round isn't due until 2026-10-27, and neither user decision file exists yet.

I used the advisor twice. The second check caught wrong end-of-round file counts in the task, which are now fixed: 8 modified + 2 new files, and 10 hashed paths.
